title: Grazr Components Zone Pro Single-Speed Tensioner
content:
Is your frame cursed with no sliding dropouts or rockers? And you can’t get enough tension with an EBB? Wanna run your full-suspension bike single-speed? Check out the Grazr Components Zone Pro ($375) adjustable clutch single-speed tensioner. It’s gotta be the highest-end product of its kind…

The Zone Pro is Grazr Components’ rebuildable and adjustable single-speed tensioner. Designed to prioritize adjustability and maximum chain retention, the Zone Pro adapts to almost any bike and setup. Built from a combination of 6061 and 7075 Aluminum, it features an adjustable clutch with 26 clicks of adjustment, is fully rebuildable, and is designed to stand the test of time.

Specs:

  • Rebuildable
  • Compatible with standard-fit derailleur hangers only; no Full-Mount
  • Main body and clamp machined with 6061 aluminum, jockey wheel cage machined with 7075 aluminum.
  • Durable jockey wheels machined from 7075 aluminum, with replaceable 689-2RS bearings.
  • Hardware made from 304 stainless steel
  • The shaft rotates on an XFM IGUS bushing for longer durability and wear resistance than standard G-spec bushings.
  • Carbon fiber clutch plates reduce wear and increase heat resistance, leading to more consistent chain retention.
  • Adjustable clutch tension, with 26 definable clicks of adjustment.
  • Adjustable main body position allows for 19mm of chainline adjustment to keep things running straight, reducing chain wear and increasing chain retention.
  • Compatible with 12t – 18t cogs
  • Integrated cage latch for easy rear wheel removal

Check out more at Grazr Components.
